jsonld.site_description: Find every civic district that covers a point or address in New York, and who represents you there.
jsonld.app_description: Click any point in New York, or search an address, to see every civic district that contains it — anywhere in the state, your county, city or town, school district, judicial district, U.S. House district and both State Legislature chambers; inside New York City, also your City Council district, community board, NYPD precinct and sector and community school district — and who represents you in each one.
jsonld.keywords: what district am I in New York, who represents me New York, New York county map, what town am I in, New York school district lookup, judicial district New York, New York State Assembly district, New York State Senate district, congressional district, NYC City Council district map, what council district am I in, NYPD precinct, community board, community school district

layers.label: County
layers.rank_note: 62 counties statewide. Inside the city a county IS a borough, which the borough layer already answers with the city's own names.

source.answers: Which of New York's 62 counties contains the point, and its population. Inside New York City the five counties are the boroughs and have no county government of their own, which the card says rather than implying a county board that does not exist.

boundary.label: New York State Civil Boundaries, the counties layer published by NYS Information Technology Services Geospatial Services, pre-built and shipped with the app

source.people: No roster is joined. New York's counties are governed in three different forms and no statewide list of who holds those seats has been found, so the card names nobody; the county tier is later work.

layers.label: School District
layers.rank_note: 716 school districts statewide; the city's own 32 Community School Districts are a different concept and stay on their own layer

source.answers: Which New York school district contains the point. Outside New York City this is the district that runs the public schools and elects a board; inside the city the Community School District layer answers instead.

boundary.label: New York State Education Department school district boundaries, published through NYS Information Technology Services, dissolved to one polygon per district and shipped with the app

source.people: No roster is joined. New York's school boards are elected locally and no statewide list of their members has been found, so the card names nobody.

layers.label: City or Town
layers.rank_note: 995 cities and towns, which tile the state; villages sit inside towns and are their own layer

source.answers: Which city or town contains the point. Cities and towns together cover every part of New York with no gaps and no overlaps.

boundary.label: New York State Civil Boundaries, the combined cities and towns layer published by NYS Information Technology Services Geospatial Services, pre-built and shipped with the app

source.people: No roster is joined. New York has 62 cities and 933 towns and no statewide roster of their officials has been found; naming some and not others would read as a claim about the rest.
source.applies: All of New York State. Inside New York City this layer says New York, because the city is one row; the borough layer is the finer answer there.

layers.label: Village
layers.rank_note: 532 villages, nested inside towns rather than beside them, so a point can be in both a village and its town

source.answers: Which village, if any, contains the point. A village is a government inside one or more towns, so a village address is also a town address.

boundary.label: New York State Civil Boundaries, the villages layer published by NYS Information Technology Services Geospatial Services, pre-built and shipped with the app

source.people: No roster is joined, for the same reason as the city and town layer.

layer_count_note: Threads 1–4: full roster (+ council, community-district, congress, state senate/assembly, election-district, borough-president, district-attorney) + 3 amenity nearest-point layers (post-office, library, early-voting)

anchor_point.note: Downtown Albany — measured inside the City of Albany, Albany County

negative_point.note: Downtown Hartford, Connecticut — outside New York State and 66 km from the nearest geometry this instance ships. NOT a water point: the county, school-district, cities-towns, villages and three legislative files are all water-inclusive off Long Island and in Lake Ontario, so a mid-Sound or mid-lake click is positive, not negative

region.sub: City districts and county legislatures not sourced here yet

geometry.note: The dissolved outline of the five boroughs, the coverage wash's FULL band (ny/scripts/build_metro_outline.py, anchor-verified inside and outside). Three rings, not one: the borough cluster plus Liberty Island and Ellis Island, both New York County land detached by water.

New York State, the coverage wash's REGION band, marking where the three statewide legislative layers answer although the city layers do not. Same builder, same simplification tolerance as the coverage ring so the two do not open slivers where they trace the same line.

The Bronx containment outline (ny/scripts/build_ny_borough_outlines.py, sliced from borough-boundaries.json) — lets a Data gaps record name this borough so the panel leads with the gaps that apply here.

Brooklyn containment outline (ny/scripts/build_ny_borough_outlines.py, sliced from borough-boundaries.json) — lets a Data gaps record name this borough so the panel leads with the gaps that apply here.

Manhattan containment outline (ny/scripts/build_ny_borough_outlines.py, sliced from borough-boundaries.json) — lets a Data gaps record name this borough so the panel leads with the gaps that apply here.
Queens containment outline (ny/scripts/build_ny_borough_outlines.py, sliced from borough-boundaries.json) — lets a Data gaps record name this borough so the panel leads with the gaps that apply here.

Staten Island containment outline (ny/scripts/build_ny_borough_outlines.py, sliced from borough-boundaries.json) — lets a Data gaps record name this borough so the panel leads with the gaps that apply here.

All thirteen New York judicial districts, dissolved from the state county fabric on the Judiciary Law section 140 table by ny/scripts/build_ny_judicial_districts.py. Replaces the five-borough crosswalk file.

New York's 62 counties from the state's own Civil Boundaries service, carrying the NYC flag that marks the five counties with no county government (ny/scripts/build_ny_counties.py). Shoreline-clipped, so it disagrees with the water-inclusive coverage ring at the coast by design.

716 school districts statewide, dissolved from the state's 936 polygon rows on SED_CODE_1 (ny/scripts/build_ny_school_districts.py). The 936 against the Census Bureau's 680 reconciles exactly: 33 New York City rows, 220 multipart and duplicate-code rows, 3 special-act districts.
New York's 62 cities and 933 towns, which together tile the state (ny/scripts/build_ny_municipalities.py).
New York's 532 villages, which sit INSIDE towns rather than beside them, so this is a nested layer and not part of the tiling.
26 NY U.S. House districts; pre-built from TIGERweb by scripts/build_legislative_boundaries.py (R2-2)
63 NY State Senate districts; pre-built from TIGERweb layer 1
150 NY State Assembly districts; pre-built from TIGERweb layer 2

rosters.note: keys every precinct (even a null CO), so the floor is the precinct count, not the commander count

Known data gaps keyed by gap id, driving the Data gaps panel — emitted from the fleet guidebook's GUIDEBOOK:BEGIN gaps block by scripts/build_coverage_gaps.py, which reads this fork's this_metro key (--check is the drift gate). Network-first like the rosters: a closed gap should stop being advertised on the next visit.

honest placeholder (floor 0): CEC members are decentralized across 32 independent council sites with no scrapable central source or Open Data dataset; card links to the DOE hub (see scripts/cec_scraper.py)
10 offices (5 BP + 5 DA), operator-maintained from official sites; floor 5 = one entry per borough (build_borough_officials.py keys by borough)
